title: 船
teacherNotes: Release integration for L211. Latest origin/main is being advanced in playable order, with R011/R012 and all prior lessons integrated before this unit, so there are no unresolved provisional learned characters. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L210 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 image anchors only as illustration style references; do not copy L058 people, clothes, faces, or body shapes.
Use L154/L162/L163 protagonist family continuity for protagonist father, mother, and little girl.
Every prompt with humans must name the role identity: protagonist little girl, protagonist father, protagonist mother, passerby fisher, or sea worker.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, boat names, pier signs, subtitles, logos, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match the sentence-specific imageNotes and keep human roles visually distinct.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, or patch production audio.
In S05, 船長 must be pronounced ㄔㄨㄢˊ ㄓㄤˇ.

approvedSentences.text: 海上風大，早點把船開回來。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 海上風大早點把船開回來
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸在海邊或碼頭旁看著海上的船，提醒要早點把船開回來；畫面要清楚有大風、海上船隻和回來的方向。不可有文字、數字、船名、碼頭招牌、標籤或水印。人物身份使用主角爸爸，外觀需依 L154/L162/L163 主角家庭 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。

approvedSentences.text: 坐船出海的人，天天早去晚回。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 坐船出海的人天天早去晚回
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 路人漁民角色或海上工作者在碼頭坐船出海，畫面可呈現清晨出海與傍晚回來的感覺，但不可使用文字、數字、時鐘刻度、船名、碼頭招牌或標籤。人物身份是路人漁民或海上工作者，必須與主角爸爸、老師、主角媽媽外觀明顯不同；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。
主角小女孩和主角爸爸或主角媽媽晚上坐船，看見黑黑的大海；畫面要安全、平靜，有成人陪同。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或字幕。主角家庭外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。
主角小女孩看著自己小時候玩船模型或看大船的照片，表現她從小就想開大船。不可有文字、日期、數字、相框標籤、船名或可辨識書寫內容。主角小女孩外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。

approvedSentences.text: 我是船長，開船飛進星海裡。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我是船長開船飛進星海裡
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在玩想像遊戲，假裝自己是船長，開著玩具船或紙船飛進像星星海洋一樣的幻想場景；這是孩子的想像遊戲，不是真實危險航行。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或字幕。主角小女孩外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。注意「船長」的「長」讀 ㄓㄤˇ。
